summary: Analog-style synth bass: punchy, house, synth-pop and synthwave
label: synth bass
body: Off-beat house bass, pumping 8ths in synthwave, octave disco lines. Darker: GeneralUser GS/Synth Bass 2; techno: GeneralUser GS/Techno Bass.

Register: MIDI 28-48 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Synth Bass 1, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Synth Bass 1") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
